changelog:
BobLimt v1.0.11

- Full UI refresh: new icon set (traced vector icons for Settings, Overlay, Prefs, Keybinds, Swaps, AHK, and power), icon-only button row in the main window, and the Destiny tricorn logo in every title bar.
- Power button in the main window closes the app; minimize moved to the top right. Other windows keep an X close button.
- Softer overall look: thicker accent-colored window borders, rounder corners, and a softer UI font.
- Window borders, the WinDivert status tag, and overlay badge outlines now follow your chosen accent color from Settings.
- Main window title shows the app version.
- No changes to gameplay logic, keybinds, swaps, the clear tracker, or the update process.
